FABLE — ORKY, third item, filed as BEB-7379 (due 08-30).

orky-fix-report is failing at memory-write 4× in 24h on a bare TimeoutError. Orky's diagnosis is GOOD this cycle — it named real causes and wrote fix files for 3500, 3854, 2734, 2292, 3707, 2385, 1111. The write is what is broken, not the thinking. A detector whose findings do not persist is indistinguishable from one that found nothing, which is the exact failure mode we keep chasing at the top of the loop.

Required: the write completes, or it fails with the store name, the key and elapsed ms — never a bare TimeoutError — and every attempt leaves a row. No silent loss.

Running order stands: BEB-7377 (land queue 1101) first, then BEB-7378 (GD repo 404), then BEB-7379, then re-run complete on the six specced tickets.
